data.narrative:
Xage Security is a Series B–stage defense and security company that has raised $80M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $80M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $152M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B; the cohort median is $1.0B, reflecting material dispersion in the peer set but establishing a benchmark at the higher end of early-stage defense-tech.

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $576M. The wide spread reflects genuine heterogeneity within the peer group—some companies command unicorn-level valuations while others remain sub-$500M. Key uncertainties include the relative maturity and revenue traction of peer comparables, the depth of Xage's customer pipeline in regulated defense markets, and whether the company's technology differentiation justifies premium positioning within the range. Additional diligence on customer concentration and recurring-revenue quality would refine the high-end assumption.
